market_summary: The holiday-shortened week ended higher for major indexes, with outside research showing gains concentrated in semiconductors, memory, AI infrastructure, industrials, and small caps while oil and energy lagged sharply. That confirmed the profile's early macro relief thesis, but daily observations were right to call the actionable tape neutral because many watched longs lacked breadth, VWAP, peer, or price-range confirmation. VIX stayed contained in the mid-teens into the week ending 2026-06-19, but the Fed's less friendly rate message and crowded AI leadership made chasing gaps unattractive. The best process outcome was staying flat when QCOM, GM, HOOD, and later MU did not satisfy their execution gates.

worst_trade.lesson: No losing trade occurred; the key lesson is to keep failed catalyst gaps on avoid or repair-watch status until price, VWAP, and peer confirmation all repair.

momentum.notes: Momentum existed in AI, memory, and semiconductor names, but profile candidates were mixed: QCOM failed below its planned range on 2026-06-16, HOOD had unconfirmed momentum, and MU was only eligible if VWAP and peer confirmation appeared.

mean_reversion.notes: No mean-reversion trade fired and the profile did not document a qualified reversal setup.

trend.notes: No trend-following trade fired; broad index gains were real, but monitored names did not provide clean trend entries inside the profile's gates.

volume_breakout.notes: No volume-breakout trade fired; elevated volume in HOOD was explicitly not enough without opening-range and fintech/crypto confirmation.

support_resistance.notes: Support and range gates worked as risk filters: QCOM below 220.50, GM below 84.00-86.00, and HOOD below plan references all stayed watch-only instead of becoming late entries.

vwap.notes: VWAP confirmation repeatedly blocked low-quality entries in GM, QCOM, HOOD, and MU. It reduced trade count to zero, but that matched the evidence from failed or incomplete setups.

relative_strength.notes: Peer and index confirmation requirements were useful: semiconductor breadth and SMH confirmation were needed for QCOM/MU, while fintech and crypto confirmation were needed for HOOD and were not proven.

news_catalyst.notes: News generated useful watchlist ideas, but several headlines were crowded or incomplete. The profile correctly avoided QCOM, GM, and HOOD, but missed cleaner catalysts in MRNA, SPCX, and AMKR.

patterns_confirmed.name: crowded_ai_gap_requires_vwap_confirmation
patterns_confirmed.notes: QCOM failed after the initial AI/Tenstorrent gap and MU was kept watch-only despite a strong memory-stock backdrop because VWAP and peer confirmation were not explicit.

patterns_confirmed.name: headline_without_opening_range_hold_is_avoid
patterns_confirmed.notes: HOOD repeatedly had headline or repair-watch interest but no confirmed opening-range hold, VWAP reclaim, or fintech/crypto confirmation.

patterns_confirmed.name: failed_buy_range_requires_fresh_thesis
patterns_confirmed.notes: QCOM, GM, and HOOD all stayed invalidated or repair-watch after failing original buy references; none should be recycled as longs without a new setup.

patterns_confirmed.name: action_specific_confidence_needed
patterns_confirmed.notes: Late high confidence on 2026-06-16 and 2026-06-17 described confidence to avoid, not confidence to buy, so confidence must be tagged by action.

new_rules: Do not convert a failed catalyst gap into a repair long until price reclaims the failed zone, holds VWAP after the first hour, and outperforms the relevant peer ETF.
Record confidence by action type: long-entry confidence, avoid confidence, and data-quality confidence must not be aggregated into one bullish score.
When AI or memory leadership is crowded, buy only pullbacks or retests inside the planned range; if price is above range before VWAP proof, wait.
Add FDA/regulatory, off-cycle earnings, and supplier-deal scans to the morning catalyst screen so healthcare and cleaner company-specific movers are not missed on mixed index days.
regime_forecast: Neutral-to-risk-on but selective: falling oil and contained VIX support risk appetite, while the Fed's higher-for-longer messaging and crowded AI leadership argue against chasing. Next week should favor confirmed breadth, semiconductors with peer support, and company-specific earnings or regulatory catalysts over stale headline gaps.
focus_areas: Separate avoid confidence from buy confidence in every monitor output.
Require breadth and QQQ/SPY or SMH/QQQ relative confirmation before approving growth or semiconductor longs.
Treat failed buy ranges as invalidated until a fresh setup forms.
Broaden the catalyst scan beyond AI and macro relief to FDA, off-cycle earnings, supplier deals, and IPO-linked momentum.
